items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: If you listen to some of Bob Wills’ records, especially the pre-War ones, they’re out swinging a lot of those big bands out of New York and Chicago

ctx.x: I’m forming a question here because it fascinates me, and I don’t know if you can do this, but if you were at a cocktail party and someone asks you, “Well what is the blues anyway” what’s the first thing that you want to say about it, if you want to try and bother?

I don’t know, I mean it’s not a word that requires a precise definition. I mean it’s not like something that would be in a scientific or mathematical appraisal. If it’s art it’s flexible. I mean isn’t Bob Wills a pretty good blues singer? So what is he singing, country? Maybe. Western? Well is he singing the blues? I mean his favorite singer was Bessie Smith or does his being white disqualify it? I’m not saying yes or no to that but there’s the question. Right? If you listen to some of Bob Wills’ records,…
